imagesBlocked: Remote images blocked to protect your privacy.
trackers_one: {{count}} invisible tracker blocked (a one-pixel image that reports when the message is opened).
trackers_other: {{count}} invisible trackers blocked (one-pixel images that report when the message is opened).

authFail.dmarc: The receiving server couldn't confirm that this message comes from the domain shown (DMARC failure): the address may be spoofed.
authFail.spf: The message doesn't come from a server authorized by the domain shown (SPF failure): the address may be spoofed.
authFail.dkim: The signature of the domain shown is invalid (DKIM failure): the message may have been altered or spoofed.

unverifiedAdvice: Don't click links or open attachments unless you're sure where the message comes from.
unsubscribeConfirmTo: Unsubscribe from {{sender}}? A message will be sent from your account to {{to}}.
hasDraft: This conversation contains an unsent draft.
shortcutsHint: Shortcuts are there if you want them:
oversize: This message is large ({{size}}): only its header was downloaded.

pgp.invalid: Invalid signature ({{signer}}): this message was altered after it was signed.
pgp.unknownKey: Signed with a key you haven't imported: the signature can't be verified. Add the sender's key in Settings › Security.
pgp.decrypted: Encrypted message, decrypted on this computer.
pgp.noKey: Encrypted message: none of your private keys can open it. Import the right key in Settings › Security.
pgp.failed: This encrypted message can't be read (corrupted or unsupported).
pgp.passphrase: This message is encrypted. Enter your key's passphrase to read it.
pgp.passphraseWrong: The passphrase is missing or wrong. Try again.

smime.valid: S/MIME signature verified: signed by {{signer}}, a certificate your system trusts.
smime.invalid: Invalid S/MIME signature ({{signer}}): this message was altered after it was signed, or the signature is unreadable.
smime.untrusted: Signed by {{signer}}, but the certificate doesn't lead to an authority your system trusts (or isn't valid for email). Don't rely on this signature.
smime.addressMismatch: The certificate belongs to {{signer}}, not to the sender shown in From: this signature doesn't prove who sent the message.
smime.noAddress: The signing certificate contains no email address: it can't be tied to the sender.
smime.timeMismatch: Signature by {{signer}} is valid, but it was made more than an hour away from the message date: it may have been replayed.
smime.unsupported: Signed with an algorithm that isn't supported yet: the signature can't be verified.
smime.encrypted: Encrypted S/MIME message: opening these isn't supported yet.
